verdict.rationale: Floot's sharing docs say you can add collaborators to a project, which covers the core of multiple people working on the same project. That is the only evidence: a single line, with nothing on how a team actually shares the workspace. Missing for 10: team or organization workspaces, roles and permissions, real-time co-editing or conflict handling, shared billing or credits for teams, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
